purpose: Executable authoritative setup/expectations for downstream B1 and U1 contract tests; this file is not a wire response and shape validation is not execution evidence.

seedSemantics.projection: Seed the listed projection atomically in an isolated test database. Historical log prefix through node.lastEventSeq is outside these focused arrangements; it is retained and must never be rewritten by an operation.
seedSemantics.emptyCollections: Listed empty collections contain no records. No other active attempts or pending requests exist.
seedSemantics.canonicalHash: SHA-256 of sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON canonicalValue; these fixtures contain only ASCII strings and plain unsigned integer tokens. Actor is stored separately and authorization precedes lookup.
seedSemantics.observationMapping: adapter_observation is a normalized scenario input, not a vendor RPC or browser payload. The B1 fixture adapter maps it to the accepted C1 interface.
seedSemantics.assertionScope: All listed expected fields are mandatory assertions. Unchanged means deep equality including versions; receiptEquals means the original persisted receipt including acceptedAt/receiptId/eventSeq. Event log append must be in the same transaction as projection mutation.
seedSemantics.uiAdapter: U1 consumes the corresponding exact HTTP status/error/receipt, retains target/command identity on lost ACK, and must not claim it executed the authoritative transition.
seedSemantics.lateArchive: For late observation archival, domainProjection unchanged excludes node.lastEventSeq only; all entity versions and node.stateVersion remain unchanged. Exactly one new late observation record is appended.

scenarios.requirement: Exact generation fences stop; a rejected stale stop must not pause or cancel current execution.
Trusted transport does not grant a different actor access to this owner node. Auth precedes command lookup/CAS.
The target dialog really exists on another node/owner. This node must return404 without global lookup, forwarding, or mutations to either projection.
An identical admitted command returns its exact original receipt even when current dialogVersion changed from5 to31.
Reusing accepted commandId with different semantic content is id_conflict, not stale, and never dispatches.
Archive an old generation observation without changing the current active slot or starting another request. This observation is terminal and does not assert an unexpectedly live old executor.
Loss of an authoritative lifecycle outcome blocks dispatch. Neither timeout nor readiness refresh means terminal or permits replay.
Generic dialog.delete is fail-closed because deletion is available only through the private logical-delete coordinator.
Generic dialog.delete cannot bypass the logical-delete reservation and hold workflow even for a busy dialog.
Generic dialog.delete cannot bypass the logical-delete coordinator even for an otherwise deletable idle dialog.
